svg.title: Home network without an exchange server
svg.desc: Detailed scheme. Outside devices connect to the router's public address 203.0.113.25 or a dynamic DNS name. The router forwards TCP 2222 to the media PC at 192.168.1.20 and TCP 2223 to the phone server at 192.168.1.42, both with reserved addresses. Devices inside the home network connect to the servers directly.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Home network without an exchange server

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Fixed local addresses, port forwarding and a public address - nothing else in between
